title: Day 1 Forecast Discussion
discussion:
Ordinary to moderate thunderstorms are expected

---Risk Areas---

GRNL #1
S Germany, Austria & S Bohemia

Ordinary to locally moderate/stronger thunderstorms are expected.
The main threats are:
- Hail - up to 3cm is locally possible
- Strong wind gusts
- Heavy Rain
- Tornado - minor tornado threat exists over the Šumava area, as lls, dls, dew point and multiple other parameters overlap. If a tornado would happen it should not be strong nor long tracked.

GRNL #2
Slovakia & SE Poland

Similar to GNRL #1, but with higher probability of:
- Heavy rain
- Wind gusts
- Tornado - Same parameters as in GNRL #1 but with higher values



Strong to very strong thunderstorms are expected. Very favourable parameters for strong to very strong thunderstorms are overlapping, creating a very interesting environment
The main threats are:
- Severe to damaging wind gusts - up to 110km/h
- Hail - up to 4cm
- Heavy rain - Flash floodings very possible
- Tornado - A favourable environment for tornadoes exists. They could reach a very intense intensity if they formed.

ENHD
Poland & Czechia

Similar hazards as MDRT, but with lowered probabilities and intensity.
